imu_gravity.method: Rotate world gravity into the body frame with the current quaternion, then subtract it from proper acceleration.
imu_gravity.finding: The approximately 2g residual is not a missed gravity-compensation port. VRX Surface produces discrete vertical acceleration pulses: sampled raw vertical acceleration included approximately 0.019, 19.31, and 29.43 m/s^2. Correct subtraction of one gravity therefore leaves approximately +1g, -1g, or -2g residuals after FLU-to-body-NED conversion.
imu_gravity.finer_internal_step_probe: A temporary 5 ms internal-step probe did not remove the pulses and was reverted; no unapproved filtering or derived-acceleration substitution was retained.
imu_gravity.resolution: OPEN: requires an explicit sensor-conditioning or VRX buoyancy/integration decision; it is not safe to label this a gravity-code bug.

reset_position_variance.root_cause: The runtime launched gz sim with -r, so seeded wind/current forces acted while service discovery and pause requests were still in progress. The published reset snapshot therefore came from a variable simulation epoch.
reset_position_variance.fix: Launch the episode paused and advance only through fixed /clock-controlled steps.

real_contacts.method: Generated hull contact sensors plus the Gazebo Contact system; zero-disturbance worlds; physical bathymetry and buoy targets inside the forward hull envelope; equal-positive-thrust trajectories; no diagnostic injection.
real_contacts.finding: The real event path remains unvalidated: neither configured hull contact topic published during the collision runs. Diagnostic precedence logic still passes, but cannot substitute for transport evidence.
